sample_text_en.pdf.expected: Ingests with pypdf. Every page yields text chunks under the pypdf parser; no warnings.

sample_text_hi.pdf.expected: Ingests with pypdf. The text layer is Devanagari; chunks contain it unchanged.

sample_tables.pdf.expected: Ingests with pypdf (layout off). Numbers and row labels stay in the chunk text. With layout=auto and Docling installed, table chunks are produced instead.

sample_scanned.pdf.expected: Without Tesseract: rejected with a message that says what to install. With Tesseract and eng data: both pages become type=ocr chunks.

sample_corrupt.pdf.expected: Rejected with a clear 'appears to be corrupt' message. No crash.

sample_empty_pages.pdf.expected: Ingests. Pages 2 and 4 have no text and are reported as image-only; chunks come only from pages 1, 3 and 5.
